scope: 2026 regular season, 131 games in preserved October 12 ShownSpace export
user_definition: First throw after a stoppage such as timeout, foul or out-of-bounds restart. Routine turnover fast breaks are separate.

definitions.huck: Project definition: Euclidean endpoint distance >40 yards AND forward gain >30 yards; non-stall.
definitions.huck_sensitivity: UFA API documentation: forward gain >40 yards; counted separately, not silently substituted.
definitions.assists: Actual source Goal event, type 19. No goal-line coordinate proxy.
definitions.thrower_aec: Sum stored aEC, with zero thrower credit on drops, including stalls. Prior project reconciliation reproduced official player-game totals.
definitions.huck_cpoe: Mean of (actual completion OR drop) minus stored CP on valid-CP hucks; percentage points. Raw stored cpoe is never averaged.
definitions.event_link: Exact game, source side and source index; verify type, thrower, receiver and every present raw coordinate, including throwaway landing coordinates.
definitions.sequence: Within the same side array, first attempt after recorded marker(s), with no intervening possession/point/period/pull boundary; clear after first attempt. Deduplicate by GameID+throw_sig_id.

limitations: Markers identify an operational subset. No restart-whistle or advantage flag exists; penalty-only records require validation before a confirmed dead-disc interpretation.
Ordinary OB returns, technical timeouts and unmarked stoppages are not recoverable reliably from this schema. Normal pull receptions and routine turnover pickups are excluded.
Injury timing follows recorded ordering; the feed has no explicit whistle timestamp.
No inference of upline cuts, player momentum, defensive pressure or causal individual skill.
Incomplete one-game coverage and possibly incomplete event recording limit any league-wide total ranking.
No minimum-sample skill ranking fitted. Totals describe recorded contribution and exposure; they do not establish the best hucker.

sources.known_database_raw_table: prod.game_events_raw; schema inspected in earlier DBeaver audit, rows not queried here.
